title: migrate plan plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/agent/plan to the v2 stage↔engine contract: v2 result file on every exit path, disposition vocabulary, rc ∈ {0,1}, valid_verdicts declared, router budgets in manifest, name-matched inputs, primary output confirmed, provides.role/events already present, cleanup absent.

steps.description: Write failing tests covering all v2 acceptance criteria: (a) plan-result.json written on success path with result_contract:2, verdict=pass, disposition=complete; (b) plan-result.json written on error path (invalid_plan_response) with verdict=error, disposition=unusable; (c) plan-result.json written on scope_too_large path with verdict=error, disposition=out_of_turns; (d) manifest declares valid_verdicts: [pass, error]; (e) manifest config.router has timeout_s and max_turns keys; (f) grep assert plugin.sh has ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS check before scope_manifest assignment. Run and confirm RED.

Update manifest.yaml: (1) add result_contract: 2 under provides (alongside existing role/events); (2) replace valid_verdicts: [] with [pass, error]; (3) add timeout_s: 300 and max_turns: 45 to config.router alongside existing retries/retry_on_exhaustion; (4) add new output entry id:plan_result, path:${artifact_dir}/plan-result.json, type:plan-result.json@1, format:json, required:true (not primary, no role). plan.json primary:true preserved. cleanup hook absent — plan holds no live resources, no function stub needed.

Update plugin.sh with four changes: (1) Add _plan_write_result helper (~20 lines) that writes plan-result.json with result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, and a data object; use atomic_write to avoid partial writes. (2) Wire _plan_write_result on every exit path: missing-state-file early exit (before return 2 at line ~105, verdict=error disposition=unusable); missing-goal early exit (before return 2 at line ~123, verdict=error disposition=unusable); scope_too_large (before return 10 at line ~849, verdict=error disposition=out_of_turns); error path (before return 1 at line ~861, verdict=error disposition=unusable reason=$_reason); success path (after emit_event plugin.result at line ~922, verdict=pass disposition=complete). (3) Add ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS check for scope_manifest at line ~111: if env var set, read path from it; fall back to constructed path for backwards compatibility. (4) Change return 2 → return 1 at lines 105 and 123 (rc ∈ {0,1}; rc=10 for scope_too_large is the one remaining special Wave A code).

Run npm test to confirm all new tests from step-1 pass green and no existing tests regressed. If any existing assertion breaks due to rc or exit-path changes (e.g. tests asserting return 2), repair the assertion only — not the behavior. tests/plan-test.sh must stay under 1000 lines total.

notes:
1. RESULT FILE NAME: plan-result.json — by analogy with teardown-result.json (the confirmed v2 reference). teardown writes result_contract:2 via inline printf; plan will use a _plan_write_result helper for reuse across exit paths.

2. VALID VERDICTS: pass (successful plan produced) and error (schema_violation, empty_result_envelope, invalid_plan_response, scope_too_large, missing inputs). No third verdict — the engine disposition table governs retry/abort independently.

3. DISPOSITION VALUES: success → complete; schema/empty/invalid/missing-input failures → unusable; scope_too_large → out_of_turns. All from the closed set in core/pipeline/disposition.sh.

4. RC ∈ {0,1}: plan_run returns 2 at two places (missing state_file at line 105, missing goal_text at line 123). Both become return 1. rc=10 for scope_too_large is the Wave A engine signal explicitly preserved — the issue says 'every other exit code is expressed as a disposition instead', and rc=10 is the one it documents as the remaining special code.

5. ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS: plan_run constructs scope_manifest = "$state_dir/scope-manifest.md" at line 111 with no ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS fallback. Under v2 name-matched inputs the engine resolves the path and exports it into ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS. The design plugin pattern is the model: check ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS first, fall back to constructed path for backwards compatibility. No new inputs declaration needed — scope_manifest is already in the manifest with required:true.

6. GOAL_STRING INPUT: source: external. The issue only requires source: artifacts and source: cycle_feedback become name-matched; source: external (goal text via ZBUILD_GOAL env or intake.md) is not an artifact path — no change needed.

7. CLEANUP: plan holds no live resources. cleanup hook is correctly absent. No function stub needed per issue text: 'if it has nothing to free, the hook is absent and that is recorded, not implied.'

8. PRIMARY OUTPUT: plan.json already has primary: true at manifest.yaml line 77. Acceptance criterion satisfied; step-2 preserves it.

9. PROVIDES.ROLE and PROVIDES.EVENTS: both already declared in manifest.yaml. No change needed.

10. GOLDEN DIFF: plan.json content does not change — only plan-result.json is added. Existing plan-test.sh tests for plan.json structure serve as the golden guard for the passing-run criterion.

11. ROUTER BUDGET VALUES: 300s/45 turns — based on issue body data (plan killed at 300s, 35 turns) and parity with design (600s/45). Plan is shorter-lived than design, so 300s is the right base.

12. TEST FILE SIZE: tests/plan-test.sh is currently 843 lines. Adding ~95 lines brings it to ~938, under the 1000-line cap noted in step-4.

13. SCOPE: the prior plan used the same 3 files. Verified against current tree — no drift detected. The scope_manifest input at manifest.yaml line 63 has no source: set (correct for name-matched), so no amendment is needed beyond the ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS code change.

14. #1756 ANTI-PATTERN GATE: the issue notes the plan anti-pattern gate cannot fire due to case-mismatched extraction and the discipline verdict having no consumer. This migration does not directly fix #1756 — that is noted but out of scope here. The _plan_validate_dod_discipline call remains as-is.
